name: autoscaling-scaling-demo-2replica-capacity
description: IO-T009 follow-up to the scaling-demo-sustained.json run: that run's 50rps offered load turned out to be BELOW 2-replica capacity (0% shed after scaling -- a demand-capped, not capacity-capped, measurement; see experiments/autoscaling/report.md 'honesty note'). This workload offers 80 rps (comfortably above 2x the ~33-37rps single-replica capacity band measured elsewhere in this task) against the SAME 2-replica admission-sane-v1 topology, to get a real 2-replica capacity ceiling comparable to FL-T009's fitted 33.159 rps/replica x N linear-scaling assumption.
